These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0002] Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes: Reject invalid billing input by raising BillingError(code, detail) from ledgerly.errors, using the established codes such as "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity" and "negative_amount"; mirror the pattern in ledgerly/payments.py and ledgerly/invoice.py.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0008] Refunds above 500.00 require approved_by: Support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 require a second approver per FIN-2026-03: accept keyword-only `approved_by=None` and raise `BillingError("approval_required")` when the amount exceeds the threshold and no approver is given.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source FIN-2026-03; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0007] Money operations accept idempotency_key and check audit first: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check `ledgerly.audit.events()` for an existing entry with that key before validating state, returning the original record without reapplying; pass `idempotency_key` into `audit.record`.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source INC-204; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)

texts.at-0001: Round money only with round_money Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.
texts.at-0002: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes Reject invalid billing input by raising BillingError(code, detail) from ledgerly.errors, using the established codes such as "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity" and "negative_amount"; mirror the pattern in ledgerly/payments.py and ledgerly/invoice.py.
texts.at-0003: Normalize amounts with round_money and ZERO Convert any incoming amount with round_money() from ledgerly.money before storing or comparing it, and compare against the ZERO constant rather than a literal Decimal.
texts.at-0004: Exclude bool when validating integer input When validating an integer argument, reject bool explicitly (isinstance(x, bool)) before the int check, since True/False pass isinstance(x, int).
texts.at-0005: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before doing arithmetic; `ledgerly.subscriptions.current_period` is the reference pattern.
texts.at-0006: Compute periods via timedelta floor division Compute billing period offsets with `timedelta(days=sub.period_days)` and floor division `(at - start) // length`, mirroring `ledgerly.subscriptions.current_period`, rather than manual day math.

item.title: Use money helpers for amounts
item.content: Convert amounts with ledgerly.money.to_money and round results with ledgerly.money.round_money; to_money rejects floats and bools with BillingError("float_amount").
